## Summary
Part 3 of a maker series: a **leather valet tray** — the desk/nightstand drop-zone for pocket contents — built with an integrated **Qi2 wireless charger** and an **interchangeable frame**. The description credits/references **Twelve South** (the Apple-accessories brand), suggesting the Qi2 module or the design inspiration comes from their lineup. It is a 30-second Short: a quick visual walkthrough rather than a full build log; parts 1–2 on the channel carry the earlier stages.

## Why it matters
- Pattern worth remembering: **charging built into furniture** — a Qi2 puck under leather turns a passive catch-all tray into a "drop phone here and it charges" station. Qi2's magnetic alignment matters here since the phone isn't seen when placed.
- **Interchangeable frame** = modularity: swap aesthetics/size without rebuilding the charging base. Good design precedent for any desk/EDC project.
- First design/maker capture in the vault (prior captures are trading/tech) — starts a `design` thread to link future captures against.
